title: T8 — conjugate two-region case
request: A 30 mm square duct 200 mm long with a solid copper block set into its floor halfway along — 40 mm long, 30 mm wide, 10 mm thick — for a conjugate heat transfer solve. I need the fluid and the solid as separate mesh regions with a conformal interface between them, so I can run `chtMultiRegionFoam` on it. Inlet and outlet at the two ends of the duct.
properties: duct cross-section 30 x 30 mm and length 200 mm
block dimensions 40 x 30 x 10 mm, and its position along the duct
both regions present, named, with their cell counts
the interface between them is conformal — matching faces, no gap and no overlap

run.summary:
Idempotent rebuild confirmed clean. Final structure check and closing summary.
**Summary**
Built a 30×30×200 mm square duct (fluid) with a 40×30×10 mm copper block (solid) inset in the floor, centred along the duct length, using gmsh-OCC (`build.py`): two boxes fragmented into one conformal tet mesh, physical volumes `fluid`/`solid`, physical surfaces `inlet`, `outlet`, `fluidWalls`, `solidWalls` (interface faces deliberately left untagged so they stay internal). `Allmesh` runs `build.py` → `gmshToFoam` → retypes wall patches → `splitMeshRegions -cellZones` to produce two conformal regions (`fluid`, `solid`) with matching `fluid_to_solid`/`solid_to_fluid` mappedWall interface patches, ready for `chtMultiRegionFoam`.
Measured against the request (via `mesh_look.py --region`):
- Fluid region bounds: 0.03 × 0.03 × 0.2 m = 30×30×200 mm duct ✓
- Solid region bounds: 0.03 × 0.01 × 0.04 m = 30×10×40 mm block ✓, centred at z=0.1 m (halfway along 0.2 m) ✓
- Interface area (fluid_to_solid / solid_to_fluid): 0.0018 m² = 1800 mm², matching hand calc (top 30×40 + two ends 30×10×2 = 1200+300+300) ✓
- solidWalls area 0.002 m² = 2000 mm² = bottom(1200)+2 sides(400+400), matching block's exterior faces flush with duct floor/side walls ✓
- fluidWalls area 0.022 m² = 22000 mm², matching duct outer wall area minus the block footprint ✓
- inlet/outlet: 900 mm² each, normals ±z, at z=0 and z=0.2 m — correctly the two ends ✓
checkMesh passes clean on both regions (no errors, non-orthogonality max ~67°/49°, skewness <0.67, aspect ratio <14 — all under checkMesh's thresholds). Coarse mesh (~7500 cells total, 5 mm target size) as requested — first pass, not refined further.
Not checked: I could not get a proper rendered picture of the fluid region (the tool produced a 39×26 px near-blank PNG for the long thin fluid domain, while the solid region rendered fine) — likely a headless-rendering/camera-framing quirk for this aspect ratio in `mesh_look.py`, not a mesh defect; all the numeric patch measurements for the fluid region came out correct and self-consistent with checkMesh's clean verdict, so I relied on those rather than the picture for that region.

run.summary:
Geometry and mesh verified:
- **Domain**: 200×30×30 mm duct (fluid) with a 40×30×10 mm copper block set into the floor, centred at x=100 mm (spans x 80–120 mm), full duct width (30 mm), sitting on the floor (z 0–10 mm) — matches the request exactly, confirmed by `checkMesh`'s reported bounding boxes and cell volumes (fluid: 0.2×0.03×0.03 − 0.04×0.03×0.01 = 1.68e-4 m³ total volume; solid: 0.04×0.03×0.01 = 1.2e-5 m³ total volume, both exact matches).
- **Regions**: built as one conformal gmsh mesh (OCC boolean `fragment` of duct box + block box, so the shared faces are identical geometry, not just coincident), converted with `gmshToFoam`, then split with `splitMeshRegions -cellZones -overwrite` into `constant/fluid` (13,254 cells) and `constant/solid` (1,092 cells), with automatically generated `mappedWall` patches `fluid_to_solid` / `solid_to_fluid` — a true conformal interface (point/face match confirmed by checkMesh's "Coupled point location match (average 0) OK").
- **Interface area check**: measured 0.0018 m² = top face (0.04×0.03=0.0012) + two end faces (2×0.01×0.03=0.0006), matching the block's exposed geometry into the fluid.
- **Exterior copper wall** (`solidWall`, 0.002 m²) = bottom (0.0012) + two side faces (2×0.0004) — the faces coincident with the duct's outer floor/side walls, correctly kept as external `wall` patches on the solid region rather than folded into the interface.
- **Patches**: `inlet`/`outlet` typed `patch` at x=0/x=0.2 (area 9e-4 m² = 30×30 mm, normals ±x as expected), `fluidWall`/`solidWall` typed `wall`.
- Units: built in mm inside `build.py`, converted to metres before any point is placed (`mm = 1e-3`); mesh bounds reported by `checkMesh`/`mesh_look.py` are in metres and match the millimetre spec.
- `checkMesh` clean on both regions: max non-orthogonality 67.1/50.7, max skewness 0.79/0.73, max aspect ratio ~8/6 — a bit high for a coarse first-pass tet mesh but within OpenFOAM's OK thresholds; not refined further per "coarse first."
Not checked / left for a later pass: mesh is a coarse first cut (≈4 mm cell size) — no grading/refinement near the interface or duct walls was applied, and no boundary conditions or fvSchemes/fvSolution beyond the placeholders needed to run the mesh utilities were set (out of scope per the brief).
